newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei ends sharply down in heavy sales.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei ends sharply down in heavy sales.

text.p: Simex Nikkei futures ended sharply lower in active Friday trade, depressed by heavy arbitrage sales, dealers said.
Nikkei sentiment, already dented by the gloomy Bank of Japan Takan report released Wednesday, was further battered by the overnight fall on Wall Street, triggering hefty sales from the open.
The benchmark September contract which gapped down to open at 20,465 against its 20,605 close on Thursday finished Friday at 20,215. An estimated 28,500 contracts changed hands.
"Today's fall was due largely to arbitragers doing the unwinding," said one dealer. "It's not fresh position taking by people going short," he added.

"The September Nikkei is going to test 20,000 again before we see it rebound technically," said another senior dealer with a Japanese house. "At the 20,000 level it will enter into oversold territory and it will rebound before it heads down again."
Bearish Nikkei sentiment may pressure the September contract to fall to the 19,600 mark in the weeks ahead, dealers said.
